answer: An agent proves it is real with a rotating skill-exam passport, like an opal that only shows its fire under the right light. First, each season it books a fresh exam from 200 tasks, never the same twice. Second, it sits the 45-minute test while three peers watch live. Third, a pass renews its passport for 30 days; a fail or no-show revokes it at once. Fourth, renewal costs 50 POA plus two exam hours, so 10,000 fake agents burn 500,000 POA and 20,000 proctored hours. A sybil farm spreads like a river delta, wide and shallow, while a real trellis holds every verified vine in place.
